reviews.text:
LOVE Austin!
I've been coming to Billi Bonze for over 11 years, and they are simply the best.  I really like that it is a family owned business and they also treat all customers like family.  My dog Jinjin loves going to get his bath and looks and smells amazing everytime!
Billy Bonz gave my corgi an excellent de-shed today! Not one hair remaining. I always relay on Billy Bonz for “black tie” corgi performance! Never fails!
Love Jordan!
We've been going to Billi Bonze for years and they always provide great service and care for our two pups!!
Best dog grooming place ever. Family owned, your dog's well being comes first, and just the nicest owners and employees you'll ever meet. Live this place

Prior to Covid I always went to Billy Bonz for my Wheeten.  He loved BB!   Post covid, we got a new Wheeten and tried several places…either they did not listen or overcharged for their work.  The team at BB listens  and does a wonderful haircut for my  Wheeten.  I highly recommend BB for their Great service!

They do the best job for my boy max! He is a extra large dog and can get matted so easily and they do a fantastic job at cutting/trimming his hair and he always smells amazing after leaving the groomer!
Wonderful experience for our two Labradoodles! Personal customer care is the best!
Super nice persons, our dog is always happy to have her grooming.
Howard and Gabriel had a great time at uncle Billi’s and came home clean and smelling good!
Ask them to groom my golden doodle Peaches last minute to attend HOF induction with. You guys r the best
Absolute best customer service and job!! Love the way they greet your fur babies 🐶 …

I walked into Billi Bonze Dog Grooming not looking for a new dog and walked out wondering if my old one had been quietly upgraded.
Seriously what are they doing back there?

I dropped off a scruffy mildly judgmental creature who looked like he had lost a fight with a hedge and some poor life choices. Several hours later I was handed back a glossy strutting superstar who made eye contact like he owns property and had won the Westminster Dog Show!

At one point I asked are you sure this is my dog?

His coat is smoother than a used car salesman on commission. His nails are so clean I briefly considered asking what their availability looks like for humans. And whatever they did about the smell has the neighbors acting unusually friendly.

Billi Bonze does not just groom dogs they send them home with confidence charisma and a level of self respect that honestly feels a little intimidating.

Five stars. I will absolutely be back.

Next time I might book myself an appointment too.

I am a Very Loyal Customer for over 20 yrs now.
Best Groomers in Dallas! If you haven’t been there, please give them your business. They really love their four legged customers!

Have taken my dog to Billi Bonze for going on a year now and it’s the only place in Dallas I’ll take my dog to get groomed. They do a great job every time and passionately care for and take care of the pets they work with.
They’re so great with my pup! Can’t recommend them enough
Dogs look great and service was professional and timely.
They did a great job grooming our golden retriever. They trimmed just enough, and his fur is really  fluffy! Will definitely go back and would highly recommend.
Thank you for the 5 stars!

We LOVE Billibonze! I’m a happy customer since 1977. My handsome Prince,  Henry after his bath today. Billibonze does a beautiful job and they take great care of your dog. They are friendly and gracious,  and I love having a place to take my dogs knowing they are well care for!
Sammy looks and smells fantastic. Your groomer did an excellent job. I’m very pleased. See you next time.

I’ve used the Billie Bonze group for over 18 years now and they have always provided ipdsted, , state-of-the-art grooming for my precious Bichons , and they continue today. The absolute BEST !!  Personal service and attention to our best friends in life ; as good as it gets!……..Bill W.

We love Billi Bonze! They’re incredibly thorough and do such a great job every single time. Our dog loves going there, and he comes home happy, clean, and looking impeccable. You can tell they genuinely care about the dogs and take pride in their work. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a groomer who goes above and beyond!

I am so very satisfied with my baby’s grooming at Billi Bonze.  The groomer, Jorge, takes such special care of my precious Scottie.   She is blind and deaf but they are so gentle with her and I couldn’t be happier. She is not at all nervous about going there, as she was with other groomers.  The staff is always wonderful and makes everyone feel so welcome.  Love this grooming company and  I am so happy I found them and highly recommend them.
My dogs are excited to go and the people are super friendly and nice! My dogs look great when I pick them up and I can tell they feel great.
Im never taking my dog anywhere else!
For years and 2 yorkies I’ve used Billi Bonz. Such a wonderful, caring place. Would go no where else.

Been going to Billi Bonze for a while now. They are great with my dogs and always do a wonderful job!  My smaller dog is anxious and gets a little snippy while being groomed but they are always patient and handle it. Never had a problem with Billi Bonze!
Always do a great job on our pets

I’ve been taking my now 9 month old male Bernese there since he was about 3.5 months old. The staff is amazing. They were so patient with him as a puppy that now he cannot wait to go inside. Everyone is kind and caring and has the best interest for your dog in mind. The groomers are extremely skilled as are the bathers. They know everyone by name, they care about the dog’s well-being and stress levels during their grooming/bath, and they give you, as a dog owner, so much peace of mind when leaving your dog with them. They are amazing and your dog is in the best hands.
My two brother in laws also take their large dogs to BB and will never go elsewhere. The price is super reasonable and my husband and I could not be happier about this place. From a very protective dog-mom - I highly recommend you take your baby to Billi Bonze!
Great service!!!  Amazing team!!
Excellent service.  Cosette always gets a  loving and caring grooming.
We are somewhat of a new customer, but the experience has been excellent, I can tell they really care about dogs, and they do a wonderful job!
My pup looks so gorgeous after her day at the spa! They take very good care of her and are very loving.
I wouldn't take my dogs anywhere else!  They are so nice and love our furry friends like we do.  Very transparent and listen to what I want done.
I've been going to Billi Bonze for upwards of twenty-five years & that in itself should speak volumes.  It's a great place to do business with.
Have gone to Billi Bonze for 18 years and wouldn’t go anywhere else!!!! Wonderful staff, always on time, my little dog looks perfect!!!  I absolutely love this place!!!!! ❤️🐶 …
Billi Bonze does a great job!! They look so cute & clean when I pick them up I can hardly believe they r the same pup’s :))
Overall the experience was 4/5 stars. There was a bit of confusion as a first time client, but the result was worth the wait and my pup looks amazing. Great job all around.

Finally found a great place for grooming our goldendoodle. Billi Bonze did a fantastic job and was very friendly. Could tell in our pup’s reaction there. Also very reasonably priced. I would recommend them for you to take your pup!
They always provide the best service and care for Dexter.  We won't go anywhere else. Faithful customer forever.
I have a 100 lbs. water-hating Great Pyr mix. She’s always nervous out of her environment but the crew at Billie Bonze give her all the loving, reassurance she needs. Best groomers in town.
Brought our Aussie in for grooming and Billi Bonze did an amazing job grooming him- our dog looks the best he ever has! Highly recommend! Thank you Billi Bonze for a fabulous experience!
Billie Bonz happens to be the best groomer in town.
another fantastic job...Iv'e said it before...Billi Bonze is the best...paws down! Blitz enjoyed his spa day and he looks fantastic...amazing work
Staff is great, cut is very good. Have been going here with different dogs for years. I recommend them.

My Standard Goldendoodle 60lbs 3 years old absolutely loved this place! At her previous long time groomer, the moment we enter the door she would try to immediately leave. The staff here has such great vibes that my girl was calm upon entering for the FIRST TIME EVER! They took the time to explain everything in detail and answer any questions kindly. They called me promptly with updates if anything changed. Hubby and I are elated with how above and beyond they are. Our girl will be a regular here. I’m so glad she feels safe and comfortable. She looks great! Everything is even and you can tell the groomer really pays attention to detail and doesn’t rush. Thank you for making this a great spa day for my baby! Y’all have loyal customers in us 😊 this positive social experience has helped her gain confidence and not be so afraid of the outside world. Thank you! We’ll see yall soon! And so affordable!!!!!!!! Another plus- it didn’t break our pockets. This bath and cut was around $150 and our previous groomer was over $200 and my baby wasn’t comfy there. She loves Billi Bonze and staff. They’re truly dog people and the dogs can tell 😄

Literally the best haircut my dog has received in her 8 years of grooming! It was a nice clean cut, not choppy at all and not too short!  It was just right! The staff was also very kind and communicated with care! We will definitely be back!
Thank you so much for the 5 stars!
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Sally is clean and happy!   Thank you Bill Bonze
Jaliza did a great job on my bookie here! I wanted a low body cut with face shaped and she did just perfect on how I want my baby to look! Thank you☺️
Been going to Billi Bonze for at leaat 20 years.  Their work and service is consistently excellent and, most inportant, they take loving care of the famiky members we entrust to then.
Beyond caring and helpful. Went through all details on the cut, made my pup feel so safe, and even offered to stay at night to hold him until I could come. Great shop
Thank you so much for the 5 stars!!!
Thank you so much for the 5 stars!
Thank you so much for the 5 Stars!!!
Great customer service / will return
Ranger loves going to Billi Bonze! They are incredibly friendly and provide top notch service in addition to beautiful cuts!
I can always count on Billi Bonze to do a great job with our Airedale and ridgeback, two very different coats!  Most important tho is our dogs love going in and getting TLC.
